title: Speaking and Knowing
blurb: How words become understanding — from the mouth to the mind.

stops.note: To speak — a doubled root that gives us the word for 'word' itself.
To hear, to listen, to obey: in Semitic, hearing and heeding are one act.
To call — and to read aloud. Reading was a spoken act before it was a silent one.
To know. The end of the road that starts with speaking and hearing.
